scripts.features:
BARRAGE - Volleyball Legends
v3.5 Update Log
GAMEPLAY
Auto Spike & Shot Modes
Auto Spike: Automatically spikes when airborne and ball is in reach. Includes a Panic Spike mode that ignores normal gates near the floor.

Spike Conditions: Configurable gates: Above Net, Above You, Ball Approaching, Block Priority, In Front, Minimum Distance, Peak Timing.

Smart Aim (Premium): 14x10 grid targeting enemy court gaps. Accounts for enemy velocity, net threat scaling, block power, and vine wall path blocking.

Silent Aim & Tilt: Silent Aim faces camera direction on jump for manual control. Spike Tilt automatically tilts W/A/S/D mid-air toward targets.

Smart Jump (Premium): Jumps only when ball peaks/falls in reach. Delays: Fastest, Fast, Default, Slow, Slowest.

Glide Magnet: Airborne tracking toward the ball. Legit mode stops on contact; Blatant tracks full jump.

Cut Spike (Premium): Aims cross-court at opposite antenna when near net. Automatically evaluates enemy gaps and drops ball via Cut W-Tilt.

Line Shot: Aims straight down the line when standing near sidelines (1-5 studs).

Auto Serve: Mid-air hits with independent 14x10 grid aiming, auto-toss delay, serve tilt, power selectors, and line serve targeting.

Receives, Blocks, & Sets
Auto Receive: Modes: Bump, Soft Bump (speed-scaled release capped at 16 studs), Smart Bump (skips out-of-bounds balls via green/red ESP), and Set. Features Receive Magnet auto-walking via MoveTo.

Auto Block: Triggers near net. Modes: Block, Set Block (+50ms enemy set detection padding), and Net Fish (drops ball to your court via S-tilt).

Auto Set: Jumps, steers camera, and sets targeting Antennas, Sideways, or Teammates (predicts position 400ms ahead using velocity).

Auto Dive: Low-ball safety diving targeting Ball, Court, or Teammates with smooth rotation, animation lock, and a 0.5x-3x speed multiplier override.

Court Automation: Auto Play handles full court positioning and idle jitter-strafing. Auto Queue auto-joins matches, selects mode (Regular/Pro), team, and position slots. Auto Ability fires skills at 100% charge.

CHARACTER, PHYSICS, & VISUALS
Ping-Adaptive Timing: Smoothed ping tracking (85/15 EMA) automatically adjusts action windows.

Movement Bypasses: Glide Bypass offers camera-relative WASD air movement (speed 10-150). Aim Bypass frees mid-air rotation.

Modifications: Rate-limited WalkSpeed (1-100) and JumpPower (1-200) write overrides. Lowers personal gravity via a 1-100% slider.

Hitboxes: Instantiates sphere parts on CLIENT_BALL models. Smart Hitbox (Premium) swaps sizes dynamically for Block, Bump, Dive, Serve, Set, and Spike states.

Visual ESP: Features Ball ESP (closest highlight, neon trajectory beam, floor landing predictor cylinder) and Player ESP (team/opponent highlights, distance labels, and Blocker/Receiver/Jump roles mapping).

Aim & Zone Grids: Floor indicators for Spike Target, Smart Aim Area, Court boundaries, Cut Spike/Line Shot zones, and Serve target fields.

Directional Lines: Extends beams from enemy heads showing facing direction. Toggleable to Jump Only.

REWARDS, WEBHOOKS, & INTERNALS
Infinite Spins: Auto-claims ranked rewards on a 1.2s loop with rank gating (Bronze II to Silver III) and per-reward earning limits.

Quick Teleport: In-UI navigation to Lobby, Play, AFK, Shops, and Queues. Blocked during active matches.

Discord Webhooks: Sends match summary embeds (scores, MVP, streaks, comeback triggers) and rank updates. Features custom pings and a Panic Mode toggle

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer or Players.PlayerAdded:Wait()
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local customSpawnPoint, infJumpConnection = nil, nil
local ConfigFile = "DX_V3_Config.json"
local currentMoveSpeed = 50
local minimized = false
local flyBV, flyConn, camPart, camConn

local States = {
    EyeExe = false, Speed = false, Jump = false, InfJump = false,
    Fullbright = false, Noclip = false, ESP = false, Fly = false,
    Freecam = false, LowGravity = false
}

local function GetCameraRelativeDirection()
    local dir = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
    if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then dir += camera.CFrame.LookVector end
    if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then dir -= camera.CFrame.LookVector end
    if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then dir -= camera.CFrame.RightVector end
    if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then dir += camera.CFrame.RightVector end
    if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then dir += Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end
    if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) then dir -= Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end

    if player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
        local moveDir = player.Character.Humanoid.MoveDirection
        if moveDir.Magnitude > 0 and dir.Magnitude == 0 then
            local look, right = camera.CFrame.LookVector, camera.CFrame.RightVector
            dir = (look * moveDir:Dot(look.Unit)) + (right * moveDir:Dot(right.Unit))
        end
    end
    return dir
end

local function SaveConfig()
    if writefile then pcall(function() writefile(ConfigFile, HttpService:JSONEncode(States)) end) end
end

local function LoadConfig()
    if isfile and isfile(ConfigFile) then
        local success, decoded = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(ConfigFile)) end)
        if success and decoded then 
            for k, v in pairs(decoded) do if States[k] ~= nil then States[k] = v end end
        end
    end
end
LoadConfig()

local function ApplyEyeMorph(char)
    if not char or not States.EyeExe then return end

            if v:IsA("Accessory") or v:IsA("Shirt") or v:IsA("Pants") or v:IsA("CharacterMesh") or v:IsA("BodyColors") then v:Destroy() end
        end
        for _, v in pairs(model:GetChildren()) do v.Parent = char end
        model:Destroy()
    end)
end

    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton", btnContainer)
    btn.Text = text; btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)

    btn.AutoButtonColor = false
    Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
  
    local btnStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", btn)
    btnStroke.Thickness = 1.5; btnStroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
    
    local function update()
        if stateKey then
            btn.BackgroundColor3 = States[stateKey] and Color3.fromRGB(180, 20, 20) or Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 35)
            btnStroke.Color = States[stateKey] and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(80, 80, 90)
        else
            btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 35)
            btnStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 80, 90)
        end
    end

    btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function() TweenService:Create(btnStroke, tweenInfo, {Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80)}):Play() end)
    btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function() TweenService:Create(btnStroke, tweenInfo, {Color = (stateKey and States[stateKey]) and Color3.new(1,1,1) or Color3.fromRGB(80, 80, 90)}):Play() end)

    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

        task.wait(0.1)
        TweenService:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.1, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine), {Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0)}):Play()
        if stateKey then
            States[stateKey] = not States[stateKey]; update(); SaveConfig(); callback(States[stateKey]) 
        elseif callback then callback() end
    end)
    update()
    if stateKey and States[stateKey] then task.spawn(function() callback(true) end) end
end
